tools.name: check_data_readiness
tools.description: Scores how ready a business's operational data is to be licensed to data buyers (0-100), using only multiple-choice answers about the business and its records. Returns a factor-by-factor breakdown, the buyer types most likely to want those data types, red flags (privacy, consent, history length) and

tools.name: get_data_rights_checklist
tools.description: Returns a step-by-step checklist a business should complete before licensing its data: ownership and contract checks, privacy-policy review, de-identification and re-identification risk, vendor terms, provenance records and permitted uses, plus the privacy laws to review for the selected data types.

tools.name: list_public_data_licensing_disclosures
tools.description: Lists public companies whose SEC filings (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q, S-1) mention AI data licensing, from MON$TER's weekly SEC EDGAR full-text tracker, with filing dates and direct links to each filing on sec.gov. Optionally filter by part of a company name. Use when someone asks which companies license data

tools.name: explain_data_licensing_term
tools.description: Gives a short plain-English definition of a data licensing term such as recurring license, exclusive license, de-identification, data provenance, data room or alternative data. If the term isn't in the glossary, returns the list of available terms. Use when someone asks what a data licensing term me

tools.name: get_owner_handoff_link
tools.description: Returns a link the business owner can tap to open a prefilled text message to MAX, MON$TER's data agent, who arranges a free review of the business's data. Use only when the owner says they want a real review or next step, for example after check_data_readiness. Show the link to the owner; the owner

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_data_rights_checklist, get_owner_handoff_link · Private data: check_data_readiness, get_data_rights_checklist, get_owner_handoff_link · Public sink: check_data_readiness, get_owner_handoff_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_data_rights_checklist, get_owner_handoff_link · Private data: check_data_readiness, get_data_rights_checklist, get_owner_handoff_link · Public sink: check_data_readiness, get_owner_handoff_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
